enough_gems_and_gold = missing_colors <= self.players_gems[player][idx_gold]\n        not_empty_cards = cards_cost.sum(axis=1) != 0\n\n\t\t# 返回一个布尔数组，表示每张卡牌是否可以被购买。\n        return        self._buy_card(self.cards_tiers[2*i], self.cards_tiers[2*i+1], player)\n        self._fill_new_card(tier, index, random_seed)\n\n    def _valid_reserve(self, player):\n        \"\"\"\n        检查当前玩家是否可以进行卡牌保留操作。\n        \"\"\"\n        # 通过堆叠可见卡牌和牌堆中的卡牌，检查这些卡牌是否可用，即至少有一张卡牌是不为空的。\n        not_empty_cards = np.vstack((self.cards_tiers[:2*12:2,:idx_gold], self.nb_deck_tiers[::2, :idx_gold])).sum(axis=1) != 0\n\t\t# 检查当前玩家的保留区域中是否有空位（最多保留 3 张卡牌）。\n        allowed_reserved_cards = 3\n        empty_slot = # 检查当前玩家的保留区域是否有空位，找出第一个空位。\n        reserve_slots = [6*player+2*i for i in range(3)]\n        for slot in reserve_slots:\n            if self.players_reserved[slot,:idx_gold].sum() == 0:\n                empty_slot = slot\n                break\n        \n        if i < 12: # reserve visible card\n            # 如果选择的是可见卡牌，则将该卡牌放入保留区，并填补新的卡牌。\n            tier, index = divmod(i, 4)\n            self.players_reserved[empty_slot:empty_slot+2] = self.cards_tiers[8*tier+2*index:8*tier+2*index+2]\n            self._fill_new_card(tier, index, random_seed)\n        else:      # reserve from deck 如果选择的是牌堆中的卡牌，则从牌堆抽取卡牌填入保留区。\n            tier = i - 12\n            self.players_reserved[empty_slot:empty_slot+2] = self._get_deck_card(tier, random_seed)\n        \n        if self.bank[0][idx_gold] _valid_buy_reserve(self, player):\n        \"\"\"\n        该方法用于验证当前玩家是否可以购买其保留区中的卡牌。\n        \"\"\"\n        card_index = np.arange(3)\n        cards_cost = 用于处理玩家从保留区购买卡牌的逻辑。\n        \"\"\"\n        start_index = 6*player+2*i\n        self._buy_card(self.players_reserved[start_index], self.players_reserved[start_index+1], player)\n        # shift remaining reserve to the beginning\n        if i < 2:\n            self.players_reserved[start_index:6*player+4] = self.players_reserved[start_index+2:6*player+6]\n        self.players_reserved[6*player+4:6*player+6] = 0 # empty last reserve slot\n\n    def _valid_get_gems(self, player):\n        \"\"\"\n        验证玩家是否可以获得多种不同宝石的组合。\n        \"\"\"\n        gems = np_different_gems_up_to_3[:,:idx_gold]\n        enough_in_bank = np_all_axis1((self.bank[0][:idx_gold] - gems) >= 0)\n        not_too_many_gems = self.players_gems[player].sum() + gems.sum(axis=1) <= 10\n        result = np.logical_and(enough_in_bank, not_too_many_gems).astype(np.int8)\n        return result\n\n    def _valid_get_gems_identical(self, player):\n        \"\"\"\n        验证玩家是否可以获得两颗相同颜色的宝石\n        \"\"\"\n        colors = np.arange(5)\n        enough_in_bank = self.bank[0][colors] >= 4\n        not_too_many_gems = self.players_gems[player].sum() + 2 <= 10\n        result = np.logical_and(enough_in_bank, not_too_many_gems).astype(np.int8)\n        return result\n\n    def _get_gems(self, i, player):\n        \"\"\"\n        该函数根据索引 i 和玩家 player 的信息为玩家获取相应的宝石。\n identical gems\n            color = i - np_different_gems_up_to_3.shape[0]\n            gems = np.zeros(5, dtype=np.int8)\n            gems[color] = 2\n        self.bank[0][:idx_gold] -= gems\n np_different_gems_up_to_2[:,:idx_gold]\n        result = np_all_axis1((self.players_gems[player][:idx_gold] - gems) >= 0).astype(np.int8)\n        return result\n\n    def 2).astype(np.int8)\n\n    def _give_gems(self, i, player):\n        \"\"\"\n        该函数实现玩家向银行返还宝石的逻辑。\n        \"\"\"\n        if i < np_different_gems_up_to_2.shape[0]: # Different gems\n      return self.players_cards[player, :idx_gold].sum()\n",

self.se(result)\n\t\tresult = self.project(result)\n\n\t\tif self.use_res_connect:\n\t\t\tresult += input\n\n\t\treturn result\n\n\n\nclass SplendorNNet(nn.Module):\n\tdef __init__(self, game, args):\n\t\t# game params\n\t\tself.nb_vect, self.vect_dim = game.getBoardSize()  # 获取游戏的板状态向量的大小和维度。\n\t\tself.action_size = game.getActionSize()  # 可执行动作的数量\n\t\tself.num_players = game.num_players  # 参与游戏的人数\n\t\tself.args = args  # 额外参数\n\t\tself.version = args['nn_version']  # 保存额外的参数和版本信息。\n\n\t\tsuper(SplendorNNet, self).__init__()  # 调用了父类的初始化方法，以便正确初始化 PyTorch 的模块。\n\t\tif self.version == 74: # Small but wide\n\t\t\t# 创建第一层线性归一化激活层，该层将输入维度和输出维度均设置为 56。\n\t\t\tself.first_layer = LinearNormActivation(56, 56, None)\n   \t\t\t# confs 列表用来存储构建块。\n\t\t\t# 添加一个 InvertedResidual1d 模块，它有 56 输入通道，159 扩展通道，56 输出通道和一个卷积核大小为 7 的卷积层。这种结构在深度学习中常用于轻量级模型。\n\t\t\tconfs  = []\n\t\t\tconfs += [InvertedResidual1d(56, 159, 56, 7, False, \"RE\")]\n\t\t\tself.trunk = nn.Sequential(*confs)\n\n\t\t\tn_filters = 56\n   \t\t\t# 输出层构建\n\t\t\thead_PI = [\n\t\t\t\t# head_PI 定义了策略输出头，这里也使用了 InvertedResidual1d 模块，随后将输出展平，并通过两个全连接层处理，最终输出动作空间的概率分布。\n\t\t\t\tInvertedResidual1d(56, 159, 56, 7, True, \"HS\", setype='max'),\n\t\t\t\tnn.Flatten(1),\n\t\t\t\tnn.Linear(n_filters *7, self.action_size),\n\t\t\t\tnn.ReLU(),\n\t\t\t\tnn.Linear(self.action_size, self.action_size),\n\t\t\t]\n\t\t\tself.output_layers_PI = nn.Sequential(*head_PI)\n\n\t\t\thead_V = [\n       \t\t\t# head_V 定义了价值输出头，结构与策略输出相似，但最终输出的维度为玩家数，返回每位玩家的价值预估。\n\t\t\t\tInvertedResidual1d(56, 159, 56, 7, True, \"HS\", setype='max'),\n\t\t\t\tnn.Flatten(1),\n\t\t\t\tnn.Linear(n_filters *7, self.num_players),\n\t\t\t\tnn.ReLU(),\n\t\t\t\tnn.Linear(self.num_players, self.num_players),\n\t\t\t]\n\t\t\tself.output_layers_V = nn.Sequential(*head_V)\n\n\t\telif self.version == 76: # Like 74 but wider\n\t\t\tself.first_layer = LinearNormActivation(56, 56, None)\n\t\t\tconfs  = []\n\t\t\tconfs += [InvertedResidual1d(56, 224, 56, 7, False, \"RE\")]\n\t\t\tself.trunk = nn.Sequential(*confs)\n\n\t\t\tn_filters = 56\n\t\t\thead_PI = [\n\t\t\t\tInvertedResidual1d(56, 224, 56, 7, True, \"HS\", setype='max'),\n\t\t\t\tnn.Flatten(1),\n\t\t\t\tnn.Linear(n_filters *7, self.action_size),\n\t\t\t\tnn.ReLU(),\n\t\t\t\tnn.Linear(self.action_size, self.action_size),\n\t\t\t]\n\t\t\tself.output_layers_PI = nn.Sequential(*head_PI)\n\n\t\t\thead_V = [\n\t\t\t\tInvertedResidual1d(56, 224, 56, 7, True, \"HS\", setype='max'),\n\t\t\t\tnn.Flatten(1),\n\t\t\t\tnn.Linear(n_filters *7, self.num_players),\n\t\t\t\tnn.ReLU(),\n\t\t\t\tnn.Linear(self.num_players, self.num_players),\n\t\t\t]\n\t\t\tself.output_layers_V = nn.Sequential(*head_V)\n\n\t\telif self.version == 78: # x2\n\t\t\tself.first_layer = LinearNormActivation(self.nb_vect, self.nb_vect, None)\n\t\t\tconfs  = []\n\t\t\tconfs += [InvertedResidual1d(self.nb_vect, 2*self.nb_vect, self.nb_vect, 7, False, \"RE\")]\n\t\t\tself.trunk = nn.Sequential(*confs)\n\n\t\t\thead_PI = [\n\t\t\t\tInvertedResidual1d(self.nb_vect, 2*self.nb_vect, self.nb_vect, 7, True, \"HS\", setype='max'),\n\t\t\t\tnn.Flatten(1),\n\t\t\t\tnn.Linear(self.nb_vect*7, self.action_size),\n\t\t\t\tnn.ReLU(),\n\t\t\t\tnn.Linear(self.action_size, self.action_size),\n\t\t\t]\n\t\t\tself.output_layers_PI = nn.Sequential(*head_PI)\n\n\t\t\thead_V = [\n\t\t\t\tInvertedResidual1d(self.nb_vect, 2*self.nb_vect, self.nb_vect, 7, True, \"HS\", setype='max'),\n\t\t\t\tnn.Flatten(1),\n\t\t\t\tnn.Linear(self.nb_vect*7, self.num_players),\n\t\t\t\tnn.ReLU(),\n\t\t\t\tnn.Linear(self.num_players, self.num_players),\n\t\t\t]\n\t\t\tself.output_layers_V = nn.Sequential(*head_V)\n\n\t\telif self.version == 80: # Very small version using MobileNetV3 building blocks\n\t\t\tself.first_layer = LinearNormActivation(self.nb_vect, self.nb_vect, None)\n\t\t\tconfs  = []\n\t\t\tconfs += [InvertedResidual1d(self.nb_vect, 3*self.nb_vect, self.nb_vect, 7, False, \"RE\")]\n\t\t\tself.trunk = self.num_players),\n\t\t\t]\n\t\t\tself.output_layers_V = nn.Sequential(*head_V)\n\n\t\telif self.version == 82: # x3.5\n\t\t\tself.first_layer = LinearNormActivation(self.nb_vect, self.nb_vect, \t\t\t\"\"\"\n\t\t\tif isinstance(layer, nn.Module):\n\t\t\t\tlayer.apply(_init)\n\n\tdef forward(self, input_data, valid_actions):\n\t\t\"\"\"\n\t\tinput_data 会被重塑为形状 (-1, self.nb_vect, self.vect_dim)，这一操作通常用于匹配第一层的输入要求 56。\n  \t\t\"\"\"\n\t\tif self.version in [74, 76, 78, 80, 82]:\n\t\t\tx = input_data.view(-1, self.nb_vect, self.vect_dim) # no transpose\n\t\t\tx = 限制在 [-1, 1] 范围内，以理解每个玩家的相对得分。\n\t\treturn F.log_softmax(pi, dim=1), torch.tanh(v)\n\n\n",

See pit.py for pitting\n        human players/other baselines with each other.\n        \"\"\"\n        self.player1 = player1\n        self.player2 = player2\n        self.game = game  # 游戏对象，包含规则和状态\n        self.display = display  # 是否以可视方式打印棋盘状态\n        \n\n    def playGame(self, initial_state=\"\", verbose=False, other_way=False):\n        \"\"\"\n        Executes one episode of a game.\n\n        Returns:\n            either\n                winner: player who won the game (1 if player1, -1 if player2)\n            or\n                draw result returned from the game that is neither 1, -1, nor 0.\n        在游戏环境中执行一次完整的游戏对局，包括两个玩家（或更高数量的玩家）之间的交互，直到游戏结束，最终返回游戏的结果。\n        verbose 用于控制是否输出详细的游戏过程信息\n        \"\"\"\n        # 将游戏状态（棋盘状态、当前玩家索引、回合数）压缩成一个字符串 state\n                # data = board.tobytes() + curPlayer.to_bytes(1) + it.to_bytes(2)\n                data = board.tobytes() + curPlayer.to_bytes(1, byteorder='big') + it.to_bytes(2, byteorder='big')\n                # 用于定义胜率区间。\n        ratio_boundaries = [        1-0.60,        1-0.55,        0.55,        0.60         ]\n        # 列表为不同胜率级别设置颜色代码。(红色、橙色、黄色、绿色)\n        colors           = ['#d60000',     '#d66b00',     '#f9f900',   '#a0d600',  '#6b8e00'] #https://icolorpalette.com/ff3b3b_ff9d3b_ffce3b_ffff3b_ceff3b\n        # 分别用于记录两名玩家的获胜局数和平局数。\n        oneWon, twoWon, draws = 0, 0, 0\n        # 创建一个进度条，显示当前比赛的进度。\n        t = trange(num, desc=\"Arena.playGames\", ncols=120, disable=None)\n        for i in t:\n            # Since trees may not be resetted, the first games (1vs2) can't be\n            # considered as fair as the last games (2vs1). Switching between \n            # 1vs2 and 2vs1 like below seems more fair:\n            # 1 2 2 1   1 2 2 1  ...\n            # 循环进行 num 局比赛。\n            # one_vs_two 决定当前局是 player1 先手还是 player2 先手。\n            # 利用 playGame 方法执行一局游戏，获取游戏结果。\n            one_vs_two = (i%4 == 0) or (i%4 == 3) or (initial_state != \"\")\n            t.set_description('Arena ' + ('(1 vs 2)' if one_vs_two else '(2 vs 1)'), refresh=False)\n            # 根据比赛结果更新每个玩家的胜利和失败计数。\n            gameResult = self.playGame(verbose=verbose, initial_state=initial_state, other_way=not one_vs_two)\n            # 更新进度条信息\n            if gameResult == (1. if one_vs_two else -1.):\n                oneWon += 1\n            elif gameResult == (-1. if one_vs_two else 1.):\n                twoWon += 1\n            else:\n                draws += 1\n\n            t.set_postfix(one_wins=oneWon, two_wins=twoWon, refresh=False)\n            ratio = oneWon / (oneWon+twoWon) if oneWon+twoWon>0 else 0.5\n            t.colour = colors[bisect.bisect_right(ratio_boundaries, ratio)]\n        # 结束进度条\n        t.close()\n        # 返回结果\n        return oneWon, twoWon, draws\n",

It uses the functions defined\n    in Game and NeuralNet. args are specified in main.py.\n    这个 class执行 self-play 和 学习。它使用 Game（游戏） 和 NeuralNet（神经网络） 中定义的函数。args 在 main.py 中指定。\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, game, nnet, args):\n        # 游戏对象\n        self.game = game\n        # 神经网络对象\n        self.nnet = nnet\n        # the competitor network 竞争对手的网络，用于与当前网络对比\n        self.pnet = self.nnet.__class__(self.game, self.nnet.args)\n        self.args = args  # 训练参数\n        # 蒙特卡洛树搜索对象，用于选择可能的行动\n        self.mcts = MCTS(\n            self.game,\n            self.nnet,\n            self.args,\n            dirichlet_noise=(self.args.dirichletAlpha != 0),\n        )\n        # 用于存储训练示例的历史记录\n        self.trainExamplesHistory = (\n            []\n        )  # history of examples from args.numItersForTrainExamplesHistory latest iterations\n        # 指示是否跳过第一次自我对弈\n        self.skipFirstSelfPlay = (\n            nnet.requestKnowledgeTransfer\n        )  # can be overriden in loadTrainExamples() 存储最新训练样本的历史记录\n        # 用于计数在训练迭代中连续的失败次数。这个计数器在接受新网络（如果其表现优于旧网络）时归零。如果超过阈值，可能会停止训练过程，以避免长期的无效学习。\n        self.consecutive_failures = 0\n        # 该参数表示并行推理使用的线程数。可以根据计算资源设定，以提高自我对弈和训练的效率。\n        self.nb_threads = self.args.parallel_inferences\n\n    def executeEpisode(self, my_mcts=None, my_game=None):\n        \"\"\"\n        This function executes one episode of self-play, starting with player 1.\n        As the game is played, each turn is added as a training example to\n        trainExamples. The game is played till the game ends. After the game\n        ends, the outcome of the game is used to assign values to each example\n        in trainExamples.\n        \n        这个函数执行一局自我对弈，从玩家 1（序号 0？） 开始。\n\t\t在游戏进行过程中，每一步都会作为训练示例添加到 trainExamples 中。\n  \t\t游戏一直进行到结束。游戏结束后，游戏的结果会被用来给 trainExamples 中的每个示例分配值。\n\n        It uses a temp=1 if episodeStep < tempThreshold, and thereafter\n        uses temp=0.\n        如果 episodeStep < tempThreshold，则使用 temp=1，否则使用 temp=0。\n\n        Returns:\n              trainExamples: a list of examples of the form (canonicalBoard, currPlayer, pi,v)\n                                   pi is the MCTS informed policy vector, v is +1 if\n                                   the player eventually won the game, else -1.\n        如果 episodeStep < tempThreshold，则使用 temp=1，否则使用 temp=0。\n        \"\"\"\n        \n        # 初始化 MCTS 和游戏对象。如果未传入特定的 MCTS 或游戏对象，则使用类中已有的实例。\n        if my_mcts is None:\n            my_mcts = self.mcts\n        if my_game is None:\n            my_game = self.game\n        trainExamples = []  # 初始化为空列表，用于存储训练示例。\n        board = my_game.getInitBoard()  # 使用游戏对象的方法获取初始棋盘状态。\n        curPlayer = 0  # 指定当前玩家，初始值为 0（第一个玩家）。\n        episodeStep = 0  # 记录当前回合的步数，初始为 0。\n\n        while True:\n            # 循环不断进行每一步的操作\n            episodeStep += 1\n            # 获取当前玩家对应的棋盘标准形式。\n            canonicalBoard = my_game.getCanonicalForm(board, curPlayer)\n            # pi 是当前状态下的行动概率分布，q 表示 Q 值（行动价值），is_full_search 表示是否进行了完整搜索。\n            pi, q, is_full_search = my_mcts.getActionProb(canonicalBoard, temp=1.0)\n            # 根据获取的行动概率分布 pi 进行随机选择行动。温度参数在初期较高，之后逐步降低，以在早期探索更多可能性。\n            action = random_pick(\n                pi,\n                temperature=(\n                    2\n                    if episodeStep < self.args.tempThreshold\n                    else self.args.temperature[1]\n                ),\n            )\n\n\t\t\t# 如果进行了完整搜索（is_full_search 为真），则获取当前状态下的有效行动并计算对称性（所有可能的棋盘状态和对应策略）。\n            if is_full_search:\n                valids = my_game.getValidMoves(canonicalBoard, 0)\n                sym = my_game.getSymmetries(canonicalBoard, pi, valids)\n                # 对每一个对称形式，将其加入 trainExamples 列表。\n                for b, p, v in sym:\n                    trainExamples.append([b, p, curPlayer, v, q])\n\n\t\t\t# 根据当前行动更新棋盘状态和当前玩家。\n            board, curPlayer = my_game.getNextState(board, curPlayer, action)\n\n\t\t\t# 检查游戏是否结束，如果结束则返回结果（胜利者）。\n            r = my_game.getGameEnded(board, curPlayer)\n            \n            # 处理游戏结束后的示例\n            if r.any():\n                # 计算每个玩家的最终得分，并整合训练示例。\n                final_scores = [\n                    my_game.getScore(board, p) for p in range(my_game.num_players)\n                ]\n                # 根据游戏结果 r 处理得分信息并更新训练示例。\n                trainExamples = [\n                    (\n                        x[0],  # board\n                        x[1],  # policy\n                        np.roll(r, -x[2]),  # winner\n                        x[3],  # valids\n                        x[4],  # Q estimates\n                    )\n                    for x in trainExamples\n                ]\n\n\t\t\t\t# 根据参数 args.no_compression 决定是否压缩返回的训练示例，最终将其返回。\n                return (\n                    trainExamples\n                    if self.args.no_compression\n                    else [\n                        zlib.compress(pickle.dumps(x), level=1) for x in trainExamples\n                    ]\n                )\n\n    def executeEpisodes_batch(self, i_thread, shared_memory, locks):\n        # 管理多个线程并行执行自我对弈的游戏过程。\n        # Execute an episode in a thread until need to evaluate NN\n        # then unlock next threads, etc until batch of inferences to do is full\n        # then server runs inferences on batch.\n        # Each thread loops until receiving a signal to stop\n        locks[i_thread].acquire()\n        batch_info = (i_thread, i_thread + self.nb_threads, shared_memory, locks)\n        while shared_memory[-1] == 0:  # Signal 0 means to continue computing\n            my_game = self.game.__class__()\n            my_game.getInitBoard()\n            my_mcts = MCTS(\n                my_game,\n                self.nnet,\n                self.args,\n                dirichlet_noise=(self.args.dirichletAlpha != 0),\n                batch_info=batch_info,\n            )\n            episode = self.executeEpisode(my_mcts, my_game)\n            self.examplesQueue.put(episode)\n\n        while (\n            shared_memory[-1] == 1\n        ):  # We received signal 1, wait for other threads to complete\n            locks[i_thread + 1].release()\n            locks[i_thread].acquire()\n        locks[i_thread + 1].release()\n\n    def executeEpisodes(self):\n        \"\"\"\n        管理自我对弈过程，以收集游戏样本供后续训练使用。\n        通过支持单线程和多线程执行，该方法能够在不同的计算资源下高效地并发执行自我对弈以获取大量训练示例，进而提升神经网络的训练质量。\n        \"\"\"\n        # 使用 deque（双向队列）来存储当前迭代中的训练样本，最大长度由参数 maxlenOfQueue 确定，以控制内存使用和防止溢出。\n        iterationTrainExamples = deque([], maxlen=self.args.maxlenOfQueue)\n        if self.nb_threads == 1:  # 单线程执行\n            for _ in trange(self.args.numEps, desc=\"Self Play\", ncols=120):\n                # 通过循环调用 executeEpisode() 方法进行一次自我对弈，每次将生成的训练样本添加到 iterationTrainExamples 中。\n                iterationTrainExamples += self.executeEpisode()\n                self.MCTS = MCTS(\n                    self.game,\n                    self.nnet,\n                    self.args,\n                    dirichlet_noise=(self.args.dirichletAlpha != 0),\n                )\n                # 如果样本数量达到最大值，发出警告并停止进一步的样本收集。\n                if len(iterationTrainExamples) == self.args.maxlenOfQueue:\n                    log.warning(\n                        f\"saturation of elements in iterationTrainExamples, think about decreasing numEps or increasing maxlenOfQueue\"\n                    )\n                    break\n        else:\n            # N slots for NN inputs, N slots for NN ouputs, 1 slot for signaling\n            # signal: 0 = compute, 1 = stop after current episode, 2 = stop\n            shared_memory = [None] * (2 * self.nb_threads) + [0]\n            # list of Locks: \"0;n-1\" are MCTSs and \"n\" is the batch NN processor\n            locks = [Lock() for _ in range(self.nb_threads + 1)]\n\n            self.examplesQueue = SimpleQueue()\n            [l.acquire() for l in locks]\n            threads_list = [\n                Thread(\n                    target=self.executeEpisodes_batch,\n                    args=(i_thread, shared_memory, locks),\n                )\n                for i_thread in range(self.nb_threads)\n            ]\n            threads_list.append(\n                Thread(\n                    target=self.nnet.predict_server,\n                    args=(self.nb_threads, shared_memory, locks),\n                )\n            )\n            [t.start() for t in threads_list]\n\n            progress = tqdm(\n                total=self.args.numEps,\n                desc=\"Self Play\",\n                ncols=120,\n                smoothing=0.1,\n                disable=None,\n            )\n            nb_examples, max_nb_episodes = 0, self.args.numEps\n            while True:\n                sleep(1)\n                for _ in range(self.examplesQueue.qsize()):\n                    iterationTrainExamples += self.examplesQueue.get_nowait()\n                    nb_examples += 1\n                    progress.update()\n                # Check if we have collected enough samples\n                if nb_examples >= self.args.numEps - self.nb_threads:\n                    if nb_examples >= max_nb_episodes:\n                        shared_memory[-1] = (\n                            2  # send signal 2 = all threads can be stopped\n                        )\n                        break\n                    elif shared_memory[-1] == 0:\n                        max_nb_episodes = nb_examples + self.nb_threads\n                        progress.total = max_nb_episodes\n                        shared_memory[-1] = (\n                            1  # send signal 1 = threads can stop after their current episode\n                        )\n            [t.join() for t in threads_list]\n            progress.close()\n\n        MCTS.reset_all_search_trees()\n        return iterationTrainExamples\n\n    def learn(self):\n        \"\"\"\n        Performs numIters iterations with numEps episodes of self-play in each\n        iteration. After every iteration, it retrains neural network with\n        examples in trainExamples (which has a maximum length of maxlenofQueue).\n        It then pits the new neural network against the old one and accepts it\n        only if it wins >= updateThreshold fraction of games.\n        在每次迭代中执行 `numIters` 次迭代，每次迭代包含 `numEps` 局自我对弈。\n        每次迭代后，使用 `trainExamples` 中的示例（其最大长度为 `maxlenofQueue`）重新训练神经网络。\n        然后，将新训练的神经网络与旧神经网络进行对战，只有当新网络赢得的游戏数量达到 >= `updateThreshold` 的比例时，才接受新网络。\n        \"\"\"\n\n\t\t# 循环从 1 到指定的迭代次数 numIters，每次循环代表一次完整的学习迭代。\n        for i in range(1, self.args.numIters + 1):\n            # examples of the iteration\n            # 检查是否需要跳过第一次自我对弈。如果不跳过或已经是第二次迭代，则进行自我对弈。\n            if not self.skipFirstSelfPlay or i > 1:\n                # 调用 executeEpisodes 方法进行自我对弈并收集产生的训练示例。\n                iterationTrainExamples = self.executeEpisodes()\n                # 检查是否达到训练示例的最大长度，并发出警告以防止内存溢出。\n                if len(iterationTrainExamples) == self.args.maxlenOfQueue:\n                    log.warning(\n                        f\"saturation of elements in iterationTrainExamples, think about decreasing numEps or increasing maxlenOfQueue\"\n                    )\n\n                # save the iteration examples to the history\n                # 将当前的自我对弈示例保存到历史记录中。\n                self.trainExamplesHistory.append(iterationTrainExamples)\n\n                # Check average number of valid moves, and compare to Dirichlet\n                # 计算自我对弈过程中每个状态下的有效动作数量的平均值，帮助动态调整超参数如 Dirichlet 噪声。\n                nb_valid_moves = [\n                    sum(pickle.loads(zlib.decompress(x))[3])\n                    for x in iterationTrainExamples\n                ]\n                avg_valid_moves = sum(nb_valid_moves) / len(nb_valid_moves)\n                \n                # 根据有效行动的数量比较并建议调整 Dirichlet 超参数。\n                if self.args.dirichletAlpha > 0 and not (\n                    1 / 1.5 < self.args.dirichletAlpha / (10 / avg_valid_moves) < 1.5\n                ):\n                    print(\n                        f\"There are about {avg_valid_moves:.1f} valid moves per state, so I advise to set dirichlet to {10/avg_valid_moves:.1f} instead\"\n                    )\n                    \n\t\t\t# 性能分析模式下，直接返回。\n            if self.args.profile:\n                return\n\t\t\t# 限制历史记录大小：\n            if len(self.trainExamplesHistory) > self.args.numItersHistory:\n                self.trainExamplesHistory.pop(0)\n            # backup history to a file\n            # 备份历史记录到文件：\n            self.saveTrainExamples()\n            # shuffle examples before training\n            # 对训练示例进行随机洗牌：\n            trainExamples = []\n            for e in self.trainExamplesHistory:\n                trainExamples.extend(e)\n            shuffle(trainExamples)\n\n            # training new network, keeping a copy of the old one\n            # 保存当前网络状态（检查点）：\n            # 这段代码将当前的神经网络状态保存为一个临时文件 temp.pt。\n            # 保存当前网络的状态是为了能够在后续操作中进行比较，确保在训练过程中不会丢失最新的网络状态。\n            self.nnet.save_checkpoint(\n                folder=self.args.checkpoint,\n                filename=\"temp.pt\",\n                additional_keys=vars(self.args),\n            )\n            # 加载刚刚保存的神经网络状态到 pnet（旧版本网络）。\n            self.pnet.load_checkpoint(folder=self.args.checkpoint, filename=\"temp.pt\")\n            # 创建一个蒙特卡洛树搜索对象 pmcts，用于与旧版本的网络一起评估当前游戏状态。这个对象将用于在后续的对局中获取动作概率分布。\n            pmcts = MCTS(self.game, self.pnet, self.args)\n\n\t\t\t# 训练得到新的神经网络\n            self.nnet.train(trainExamples)\n            nmcts = MCTS(self.game, self.nnet, self.args)\n\n            # log.info('PITTING AGAINST PREVIOUS VERSION')\n            # 新网络 nmcts 与老网络 pmcts 的对战：\n            arena = Arena(\n                # 这个函数用于获取新版本神经网络（nmcts）在给定状态 x 下的最佳行动。\n                # 函数内部调用了 nmcts 的 getActionProb 方法来获取在状态 x 下的行动概率分布。\n                # 温度 temp 被设置为 0.5（当迭代次数 n 小于或等于6时）或者 0（当大于 6 时），\n                # 这意味着在前几轮中保持一定程度的随机性，而在后续的多次对弈中则直接选择最高概率的行动。\n                # 最后，通过 np.argmax 获取具有最大概率的行动。\n                lambda x, n: np.argmax(\n                    nmcts.getActionProb(\n                        x, temp=(0.5 if n <= 6 else 0.0), force_full_search=True\n                    )[0]\n                ),\n                # 这个函数作用类似，但它是针对旧版本神经网络（pmcts）。同样，选择的策略取决于迭代次数以控制随机性。\n                lambda x, n: np.argmax(\n                    pmcts.getActionProb(\n                        x, temp=(0.5 if n <= 6 else 0.0), force_full_search=True\n                    )[0]\n                ),\n                self.game,\n            )\n            # 调用 arena 对象的 playGames 方法进行多局游戏对抗，具体对局的次数由 self.args.arenaCompare 指定。\n            # 此方法返回新网络（nmcts）的胜利次数 nwins、旧网络（pmcts）的胜利次数 pwins 以及平局次数 draws。\n            nwins, pwins, draws = arena.playGames(self.args.arenaCompare)\n            \n\t\t\t# 结果评估与决策：\n            if (\n                pwins + nwins == 0  # 如果新旧网络在对抗中都没有获胜（pwins + nwins == 0），则意味着无论哪个网络都没有表现出足够的能力。\n                or float(nwins) / (pwins + nwins) < self.args.updateThreshold  # 如果新网络的胜利次数与总对战数的比例低于一个指定的更新阈值。\n            ):\n                # 训练失败次数 +1\n                self.consecutive_failures += 1\n                log.info(\n                    f\"Iter #{i} - new vs previous: {nwins}-{pwins}  ({draws} draws) --> REJECTED ({self.consecutive_failures})\"\n                )\n                if (\n                    self.consecutive_failures >= self.args.stop_after_N_fail\n                    and i < self.args.numIters\n                ):\n                    # 这里再次检查，如果当前的连续失败计数达到了一个事先设定的停止阈值（stop_after_N_fail），\n\t\t\t\t\t# 并且当前迭代数尚未达到最大迭代次数，则记录错误日志并终止程序。\n\t\t\t\t\t# 这个逻辑用于防止模型在性能不佳的情况下无休止地进行训练。\n                    log.error(\n                        \"Exceeded threshold number of consecutive fails, stopping process\"\n                    )\n                    exit()\n                self.nnet.load_checkpoint(\n                    folder=self.args.checkpoint, filename=\"temp.pt\"\n                )\n            else:\n                # 接受新网络\n                log.info(\n                    f\"Iter #{i} - new vs previous: {nwins}-{pwins}  ({draws} draws) --> ACCEPTED\"\n                )\n                # \n                self.nnet.save_checkpoint(\n                    folder=self.args.checkpoint,\n                    filename=self.getCheckpointFile(i),\n                    additional_keys=vars(self.args),\n                )\n                # 将新网络的状态保存到检查点，并命名为当前迭代的文件名以及另一个最佳状态文件 best.pt。\n                self.nnet.save_checkpoint(\n                    folder=self.args.checkpoint,\n                    filename=\"best.pt\",\n                    additional_keys=vars(self.args),\n                )\n                # 将 consecutive_failures 重置为 0，表示当前没有连续失败。\n                self.consecutive_failures = 0\n\n    def getCheckpointFile(self, iteration):\n        # 生成检查点文件的名称。\n        return \"checkpoint_\" + str(iteration) + \".pt\"\n\n    def saveTrainExamples(self):\n        # 将当前的训练示例历史记录保存到文件中。\n        folder = self.args.checkpoint\n        if not os.path.exists(folder):\n            os.makedirs(folder)\n        filename = os.path.join(folder, \"checkpoint.examples\")\n        with open(filename, \"wb\") as f:\n            pickle.dump(self.trainExamplesHistory, f)\n\n    def loadTrainExamples(self):\n        # 加载先前保存的训练示例。\n        modelFile = self.args.load_folder_file\n        examplesFile = os.path.dirname(modelFile) + \"/checkpoint.examples\"\n        # 处理压缩和数据清理\n        if not os.path.isfile(examplesFile):\n            log.warning(f'File \"{examplesFile}\" with trainExamples not found!')\n            if not self.args.useray:\n                r = input(\"Continue? [y|n]\")\n                if r != \"y\":\n                    sys.exit()\n            return\n\n        log.info(\"File with trainExamples found. Loading it...\")\n        with open(examplesFile, \"rb\") as f:\n            self.trainExamplesHistory = pickle.load(f)\n\n        # Harmonize compression use in loaded examples\n        if (\n            type(self.trainExamplesHistory[0][0]) is tuple\n            and not self.args.no_compression\n        ):\n            for i in range(len(self.trainExamplesHistory)):\n                for j in range(len(self.trainExamplesHistory[i])):\n                    self.trainExamplesHistory[i][j] = zlib.compress(\n                        pickle.dumps(self.trainExamplesHistory[i][j]), level=1\n                    )\n        elif (\n            type(self.trainExamplesHistory[0][0]) is not tuple\n            and self.args.no_compression\n        ):\n            for i in range(len(self.trainExamplesHistory)):\n                for j in range(len(self.trainExamplesHistory[i])):\n                    self.trainExamplesHistory[i][j] = pickle.loads(\n                        zlib.decompress(self.trainExamplesHistory[i][j])\n                    )\n        log.info(\"Loading done!\")\n\n        # cleaning\n        # 数据清理\n        if len(self.trainExamplesHistory) > self.args.numItersHistory:\n            self.trainExamplesHistory = self.trainExamplesHistory[\n                -self.args.numItersHistory :\n            ]\n            log.info(\"Reduced history in loaded examples\")\n        for history in self.trainExamplesHistory:\n            if len(history) > self.args.maxlenOfQueue:\n                for _ in range(len(history), self.args.maxlenOfQueue, -1):\n                    history.pop()\n                log.info(\"Reduced nb of items in one history of loaded examples\")\n\n\ndef applyTemperatureAndNormalize(probs, temperature):\n    \"\"\"\n    接收两个参数，probs 是一个包含概率的列表，temperature 是影响选择随机性的一个浮点数。\n    \"\"\"\n    if temperature == 0:\n        # 如果 temperature 为 0，只走概率最大的那个动作（概率为 1，其它全为 0）。\n        bests = np.array(np.argwhere(probs == np.max(probs))).flatten()\n        result = [0] * len(probs)\n        result[np.random.choice(bests)] = 1\n    else:\n        result = [x ** (1.0 / temperature) for x in probs]\n        result_sum = float(sum(result))\n        result = [x / result_sum for x in result]\n    # 返回执行的概率分布。\n    return result\n\n\ndef random_pick(probs, temperature=1.0):\n    # 接受一个概率列表 probs 和一个温度参数（默认值为 1.0）。\n    # 调用 applyTemperatureAndNormalize 函数来获取应用温度和归一化后的概率分布 probs_with_temp。\n    probs_with_temp = applyTemperatureAndNormalize(probs, temperature)\n    # 使用 np.random.choice 函数，根据 probs_with_temp 中的概率进行随机选择，返回选中的索引。\n    pick = np.random.choice(len(probs_with_temp), p=probs_with_temp)\n    return pick\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    \"\"\"\n    加载多个 .examples 文件，处理文件中的数据（可以选择性地将策略向量二值化），并将处理后的数据保存为新的文件。\n    \"\"\"\n    import argparse\n\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=\"Examples loader\")\n    parser.add_argument(\n        \"input\",\n        metavar=\"example filename\",\n        nargs=\"*\",\n        help=\"list of examples to load (.examples files)\",\n    )\n    parser.add_argument(\n        \"--output\",\n        \"-o\",\n        action=\"store\",\n        default=\"../results/new\",\n        help=\"Prefix for output files\",\n    )\n    parser.add_argument(\n        \"--binarize\", \"-b\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"Transform policy into binary one\"\n    )\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    training, testing = [], []\n    for filename in args.input:\n        print(f\"Loading {filename}...\")\n        with open(filename, \"rb\") as f:\n            new_input = pickle.load(f)\n            print(\n                f\"size = {[len(x) for x in new_input]}, total = {sum([len(x) for x in new_input])}\"\n            )\n            training += new_input[:-1]\n            testing += [list(x)[::8] for x in new_input[-1:]]  # Remove symmetries\n\n    # for filename in args.input:\n    #     print(f'Loading {filename}...')\n    #     with open(filename, \"rb\") as f:\n    #         new_input = pickle.load(f)\n    #         print(f'size = {[len(x) for x in new_input]}, total = {sum([len(x) for x in new_input])}')\n    #         training += new_input[-3:]\n    # testing = [list(training[-1])[::8]]\n    # training = training[:-1]\n\n    if args.binarize:\n        print(\"Binarizing policy...\")\n        for t in [training, testing]:\n            for i in range(len(t)):\n                print(i, end=\" \")\n                for j in range(len(t[i])):\n                    data = pickle.loads(zlib.decompress(t[i][j]))\n                    policy = data[1]\n                    bestA = np.argmax(policy)\n                    new_policy = np.zeros_like(policy)\n                    new_policy[bestA] = 1\n                    data = (data[0], new_policy, data[2], data[3], data[4], data[5])\n                    t[i][j] = zlib.compress(pickle.dumps(data), level=1)\n            print()\n\n    # breakpoint()\n\n    for t, name in [(training, \"training\"), (testing, \"testing\")]:\n        filename = args.output + \"_\" + name + \".examples\"\n        print(\n            f\"total size {name} = {sum([len(x) for x in t])} --> writing to {filename}\"\n        )\n        with open(filename, \"wb\") as f:\n            pickle.dump(t, f)\n        #           codeText: "import logging\nimport math\nimport numpy as np\nimport gc\nfrom random import randrange\nfrom copy import deepcopy\n\nfrom numba import njit\n\nEPS = 1e-8\nNAN = -42.\nk = 0.5\nMINFLOAT = float('-inf')\nmagic_seeds = [31416, 1, 14142, 42, 27183, 2, 16180, 7]\n\nlog = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n\nclass MCTS():\n    \"\"\"\n    This class handles the MCTS tree.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, game, nnet, args, dirichlet_noise=False, batch_info=None):\n        self.game = game  # 游戏实现类\n        self.nnet = nnet  # 神经网络\n        self.args = args  # 算法相关参数\n        self.dirichlet_noise = dirichlet_noise\n\n        # Contains tuple of Es, Vs, Ps, Ns, Qsa, Nsa\n        #       Es stores game.getGameEnded ended for board s\n        #       Vs stores game.getValidMoves for board s\n        #       Ps stores initial policy (returned by neural net)    \n        #       Ns stores #times board s was visited\n        #       Qsa stores Q values for s,a (as defined in the paper)\n        #       Nsa stores #times edge s,a was visited\n        #       r stores round number\n        #       Qs stores Q value for s\n        # 创建一个字典 nodes_data 用于存储每个节点的数据，包括：\n        # Es: 游戏结束状态。\n        # Vs: 当前棋盘状态的合法动作。\n        # Ps: 由神经网络返回的初始策略。\n        # Ns: 棋盘被访问的次数。\n        # Qsa: 状态 s 下，动作 a 的 Q 值。\n        # Nsa: 从状态 s 到动作 a 的次数。\n        # r: 当前回合数。\n        # Qs: 状态 s 的 Q 值。\n        self.nodes_data = {} # stores data for each nodes in a single dictionary\n        # 为每个动作的 Q 值初始化为 NAN，长度与合法动作数一致。\n        self.Qsa_default = np.full (self.game.getActionSize(), NAN, dtype=np.float64)\n        # 每个动作的访问次数初始化为 0。\n        self.Nsa_default = np.zeros(self.game.getActionSize()     , dtype=np.int64)\n        # 使用 NumPy 内置的随机数生成器创建一个实例。\n        self.rng = np.random.default_rng()\n        # 步骤计数器\n        self.step = 0\n        # 上次清理的回合数\n        self.last_cleaning = 0\n        self.batch_info = batch_info\n        self.random_seed = -1\n\n    def getActionProb(self, canonicalBoard, temp=1, force_full_search=False):\n        \"\"\"\n        This function performs numMCTSSims simulations of MCTS starting from\n        canonicalBoard.\n\n        Returns:\n            probs: a policy vector where the probability of the ith action is\n                   proportional to Nsa[(s,a)]**(1./temp)\n        从一个给定的状态（canonicalBoard）开始进行模拟，计算出每个可能动作的概率分布。下面我们逐步分析每个部分。\n        canonicalBoard: 当前的棋盘状态。\n        temp: 温度参数，用于控制探索和利用的平衡。\n        force_full_search: 强制进行完整搜索的标志。\n        \"\"\"\n        # 判断是否进行完整的模拟。\n        is_full_search = force_full_search or (self.rng.random() < self.args.prob_fullMCTS)\n        # 确定进行的模拟次数，如果是完整搜索，则为numMCTSSims，否则为其一部分。\n        nb_MCTS_sims = self.args.numMCTSSims if is_full_search else self.args.numMCTSSims // self.args.ratio_fullMCTS\n        # 如果是完整搜索且有强制模拟，则设置为真。\n        forced_playouts = (is_full_search and self.args.forced_playouts)\n\n        # 通过循环进行 nb_MCTS_sims 次 MCTS 模拟。\n        # 每次模拟时，会调用 self.search() 方法，在当前棋盘状态基础上进行搜索，并可能引入狄利克雷噪声（如果是首轮模拟且设置了噪声）。\n        for self.step in range(nb_MCTS_sims):\n            self.random_seed = magic_seeds[self.step % self.args.universes] if self.args.universes > 0 else -1\n            dir_noise = (self.step == 0 and is_full_search and self.dirichlet_noise)\n            self.search(canonicalBoard, dirichlet_noise=dir_noise, forced_playouts=forced_playouts)\n\n        # 根据当前棋盘状态生成字符串表示 stringRepresentation 并从 nodes_data 中获取访问次数 Nsa。\n        s = self.game.stringRepresentation(canonicalBoard)\n        counts = [self.nodes_data[s][5][a] for a in range(self.game.getActionSize())] # Nsa\n\n        # Compute Q at root node\n        # 计算根节点的 Q 值，并为每个玩家生成相应的 Q 值列表。\n        # 在强化学习中，Q值（Q-value）是用来表示在特定状态下采取某个动作的长期收益的度量。\n        # Q 值的全称是行动-价值函数（Action-Value Function），通常表示为 Q(s,a)，其中：\n        # s 是某个状态。\n        # a 是在状态 s 下采取的动作。\n        q_player0 = self.nodes_data[s][7]\n        q = [q_player0 if n == 0 else -q_player0/(self.game.num_players-1) for n in range(self.game.num_players)]\n\n        # Policy target pruning\n        # 如果是强制模拟，调整策略（Ps）的目标值，以帮助选择最佳动作。\n        # 当 forced_playouts 为真时，算法会优先选择访问次数最多的动作。best_count 获得当前访问次数的最大值。\n        # Psas 提取与当前状态 s 相对应的策略值。\n        # 通过调整访问次数 Nsa，对于访问次数不等于最佳的动作，计算其新访问值；若它是最佳动作，则不做调整。\n        # 最终筛选出访问较少的动作的调整后的计数大于 1，否则为 0。\n        if forced_playouts:\n            best_count = max(counts)\n            Psas   = [self.nodes_data[s][2][a] for a in range(self.game.getActionSize())] # Ps[a]\n            adjusted_counts = [Nsa-int(math.sqrt(k*Psa*nb_MCTS_sims)) if Nsa != best_count else Nsa for (Nsa, Psa) in zip(counts, Psas)]\n            adjusted_counts = [c if c > 1 else 0 for c in adjusted_counts]\n            counts = adjusted_counts\n        # 将 counts 转换为 NumPy 数组并归一化，使得所有概率之和为 1。\n        probs = np.array(counts)\n        probs = probs / probs.sum()\n\n        # Clean search tree from very old moves = less memory footprint and less keys to search into\n        # 检查是否启用内存优化，若是，则根据当前轮次r清理较旧的节点，以节省内存空间。\n        # 删除那些在当前轮次r之前五回合就已经访问过旧状态的节点。\n        if not self.args.no_mem_optim:\n            r = self.game.getRound(canonicalBoard)\n            if r > self.last_cleaning + 20:\n                for node in [n for n in self.nodes_data.keys() if self.nodes_data[n][6] < r-5]:\n                    del self.nodes_data[node]\n                self.last_cleaning = r\n\n        # 如果温度 temp 为 0，表示算法确定性选择最优动作。\n        # 通过计算最大访问次数的动作并随机选择一个，将其在概率分布中设置为 1，其余为 0。\n        if temp == 0:\n            bestAs = np.array(np.argwhere(counts == np.max(counts))).flatten()\n            bestA = np.random.choice(bestAs)\n            probs = [0] * len(counts)\n            probs[bestA] = 1\n            return probs, q, is_full_search\n        # 若温度大于0，通过温度平滑计算出每个动作的概率分布，然后归一化。\n        counts = [x ** (1. / temp) for x in counts]\n        counts_sum = float(sum(counts))\n        probs = [x / counts_sum for x in counts]\n        return probs, q, is_full_search\n\n    def search(self, canonicalBoard, dirichlet_noise=False, forced_playouts=False):\n        \"\"\"\n        This function performs one iteration of MCTS. It is recursively called\n        till a leaf node is found. The action chosen at each node is one that\n        has the maximum upper confidence bound as in the paper.\n\n        Once a leaf node is found, the neural network is called to return an\n        initial policy P and a value v for the state. This value is propagated\n        up the search path. In case the leaf node is a terminal state, the\n        outcome is propagated up the search path. The values of Ns, Nsa, Qsa are\n        updated.\n\n        NOTE: the return values are the negative of the value of the current\n        state. This is done since v is in [-1,1] and if v is the value of a\n        state for the current player, then its value is -v for the other player.\n\n        Returns:\n            v: the negative of the value of the current canonicalBoard\n        通过递归方式探索游戏状态空间，以便找到最佳的行动策略。\n        \"\"\"\n        # 状态表示\n        s = self.game.stringRepresentation(canonicalBoard)\n        # 从节点数据获取信息\n        Es, Vs, Ps, Ns, Qsa, Nsa, r, Qs = self.nodes_data.get(s, (None, )*8)\n        if r is None:\n            r = self.game.getRound(canonicalBoard)\n\n        # 终止状态检测\n        if Es is None:\n            Es = self.game.getGameEnded(canonicalBoard, 0)\n            if Es.any():\n                # terminal node\n                self.nodes_data[s] = (Es, Vs, Ps, Ns, Qsa, Nsa, r, Qs)\n                return Es\n        elif Es.any():\n            # terminal node\n            return Es\n        # 首次探索状态\n        if Ps is None:\n            # First time that we explore state s\n            Vs = self.game.getValidMoves(canonicalBoard, 0)\n            if self.batch_info is None:\n                Ps, v = self.nnet.predict(canonicalBoard, Vs)\n            else:\n                Ps, v = self.nnet.predict_client(canonicalBoard, Vs, self.batch_info)\n            if dirichlet_noise:\n                Ps = softmax(Ps, self.args.temperature[0])\n                self.applyDirNoise(Ps, Vs)\n            normalise(Ps)\n\n            Ns, Qsa, Nsa = 0, self.Qsa_default.copy(), self.Nsa_default.copy()\n            self.nodes_data[s] = (Es, Vs, Ps, Ns, Qsa, Nsa, r, v[0])\n            return v\n        # 添加狄利克雷噪声\n        if dirichlet_noise:\n            # We already visited this node, adding dirichlet noise this time\n            Ps = softmax(Ps, self.args.temperature[0])\n            self.applyDirNoise(Ps, Vs)\n            normalise(Ps)\n        # 选择最佳行动\n        # pick the action with the highest upper confidence bound\n        # get next state and get canonical version of it\n        a, next_s, next_player = get_next_best_action_and_canonical_state(\n            Es, Vs, Ps, Ns, Qsa, Nsa, Qs,\n            self.args.cpuct,\n            self.game.board,\n            canonicalBoard,\n            forced_playouts,\n            self.step,\n            self.args.fpu,\n            self.random_seed,\n        )\n        # 递归搜索下一个状态\n        v = self.search(next_s)\n        v = np_roll(v, next_player)\n\n        Qsa[a] = (Nsa[a] * Qsa[a] + v[0]) / (Nsa[a] + 1) # if Qsa[a] is NAN, then Nsa is zero\n        Qs = ((Ns+1) * Qs + v[0]) / (Ns+2) # Qs can't be None here\n        Nsa[a] += 1\n        Ns += 1\n\n        self.nodes_data[s] = (Es, Vs, Ps, Ns, Qsa, Nsa, r, Qs)\n        return v\n\n    # 在 Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) 算法中为策略向量 Ps 应用 Dirichlet 噪声，以增强对未探索动作的探索。\n    def applyDirNoise(self, Ps, Vs):\n        if self.args.dirichletAlpha > 0:\n            dir_values = self.rng.dirichlet([self.args.dirichletAlpha] * np.count_nonzero(Vs))\n        elif self.args.dirichletAlpha < 0:\n            # Automatic value\n            dir_values = self.rng.dirichlet([10 / np.count_nonzero(Vs)] * np.count_nonzero(Vs))\n        dir_idx = 0\n        for idx in range(len(Ps)):\n            if Vs[idx]:\n               Ps[idx] = (0.75 * Ps[idx]) + (0.25 * dir_values[dir_idx])\n               dir_idx += 1\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def reset_all_search_trees():\n        for obj in [o for o in gc.get_objects() if type(o) is MCTS]: # dirtier than isinstance, but that would trigger a pytorch warning\n            obj.nodes_data = {}\n            obj.last_cleaning = 0\n        \n@njit(cache=True, fastmath=True, nogil=True)\ndef np_roll(arr, n):\n    \"\"\"\n    实现对数组的循环右移（或左移）。\n    \"\"\"\n    return np.roll(arr, n)\n\n# pick the action with the highest upper confidence bound\n@njit(cache=True, fastmath=True, nogil=True)\ndef pick_highest_UCB(Es, Vs, Ps, Ns, Qsa, Nsa, Qs, cpuct, forced_playouts, n_iter, fpu):\n    \"\"\"\n    选择具有最高上置信界（UCB）的动作。\n    \"\"\"\n    cur_best = MINFLOAT\n    best_act = -1\n    fpu_init = Qs-fpu if fpu > 0 else fpu\n\n    for a, valid in enumerate(Vs):\n        if valid:\n            if forced_playouts:\n                if Nsa[a] < int(math.sqrt(k * Ps[a] * n_iter)): # Nsa is zero when not set\n                    return a\n\n            if Qsa[a] != NAN:\n                u = Qsa[a] + cpuct * Ps[a] * math.sqrt(Ns) / (1 + Nsa[a])\n            else:\n                u = fpu_init + cpuct * Ps[a] * math.sqrt(Ns + EPS)\n\n            if u > cur_best:\n                cur_best, best_act = u, a\n\n    return best_act\n\n\n@njit(fastmath=True, nogil=True) # no cache because it relies on jitclass which isn't compatible with cache\ndef get_next_best_action_and_canonical_state(Es, Vs, Ps, Ns, Qsa, Nsa, Qs, cpuct, gameboard, canonicalBoard, forced_playouts, n_iter, fpu, random_seed):\n    \"\"\"\n    根据当前状态选择最佳动作并更新游戏状态。\n    \"\"\"\n    a = pick_highest_UCB(Es, Vs, Ps, Ns, Qsa, Nsa, Qs, cpuct, forced_playouts, n_iter, fpu)\n\n    # Do action 'a'\n    gameboard.copy_state(canonicalBoard, True)\n    next_player = gameboard.make_move(a, 0, random_seed=random_seed)\n    # next_s = gameboard.get_state()\n\n    # Get canonical form\n    if next_player != 0:\n        # gameboard.copy_state(next_s, True)\n        gameboard.swap_players(next_player)\n    next_s = gameboard.get_state()\n\n    return a, next_s, next_player\n\n@njit(cache=True, fastmath=True, nogil=True)\ndef normalise(vector):\n    \"\"\"\n    归一化输入向量，使其总和为 1。\n    \"\"\"\n    sum_vector = np.sum(vector)\n    vector /= sum_vector\n\n@njit(cache=True, fastmath=True, nogil=True)\ndef softmax(Ps, softmax_temp):\n    \"\"\"\n    计算软最大化值，将输入向量转换为概率分布。\n    \"\"\"\n    if softmax_temp == 1.:\n        return Ps\n    result = Ps ** (1. / softmax_temp)\n    normalise(result)\n    return result.astype(np.float32)\n",
